SELECT g.id AS id, g.goods_code AS goodsCode, g.barcode AS barcode, g.name AS name, g.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, g.brand_id AS brandId, b.name AS brandName, g.unit_id AS unitId, u.name AS unitName, g.spec AS spec, g.origin AS origin, g.purchase_price AS purchasePrice, g.retail_price AS retailPrice, g.member_price AS memberPrice, promo.promo_price AS promoPrice, promo.end_time AS promoEndTime, g.plu_code AS pluCode, g.is_weighed AS isWeighed, g.allow_return AS allowReturn, g.safety_stock_lower AS safetyStockLower, g.safety_stock_upper AS safetyStockUpper, g.status AS status, inv.quantity AS quantity, inv.cost_price AS costPrice, inv.cost_amount AS costAmount, CASE WHEN inv.quantity IS NULL OR inv.quantity <= 0 THEN 'OUT' WHEN g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND inv.quantity >= g.safety_stock_upper THEN 'OVERSTOCK' WHEN inv.quantity <= g.safety_stock_lower THEN 'WARNING' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS stockStatus, g.create_time AS createTime FROM goods g JOIN category c ON c.id = g.category_id JOIN unit u ON u.id = g.unit_id LEFT JOIN brand b ON b.id = g.brand_id LEFT JOIN inventory inv ON inv.goods_id = g.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT goods_id, promo_price, end_time FROM ( SELECT p.goods_id, p.promo_price, p.end_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.goods_id ORDER BY p.start_time DESC) AS rn FROM promotion p WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.start_time <= NOW() AND p.end_time > NOW() ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ) promo ON promo.goods_id = g.id
AND g.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.name}, '%')
AND g.goods_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.goodsCode}, '%')
AND g.barcode LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.barcode}, '%')
AND g.category_id IN #{cid}
AND g.brand_id = #{q.brandId}
AND g.status = #{q.status}
AND g.is_weighed = #{q.isWeighed}
AND g.allow_return = #{q.allowReturn}
AND (inv.quantity IS NULL OR inv.quantity <= 0)
AND inv.quantity > 0 AND inv.quantity <= g.safety_stock_lower
AND g.safety_stock_upper IS NOT NULL AND inv.quantity >= g.safety_stock_upper
AND inv.quantity > 0 AND inv.quantity > g.safety_stock_lower AND (g.safety_stock_upper IS NULL OR inv.quantity < g.safety_stock_upper)
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY
g.goods_code g.name inv.quantity g.retail_price g.create_time
ASC DESC
, g.id DESC

SELECT ro.order_no AS orderNo, ro.receipt_time AS receiptTime, roi.received_price AS price, roi.received_qty AS quantity FROM receipt_order_item roi JOIN receipt_order ro ON ro.id = roi.receipt_id WHERE roi.goods_id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY ro.receipt_time DESC, roi.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(soi.quantity), 0) AS totalQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(soi.paid_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM sales_order_item soi JOIN sales_order so ON so.id = soi.order_id WHERE soi.goods_id = #{goodsId} AND so.sale_time >= #{since}

SELECT sg.supplier_id AS supplierId, s.name AS supplierName, sg.supply_price AS supplyPrice, sg.is_default AS isDefault, sg.last_supply_time AS lastSupplyTime FROM supplier_goods sg JOIN supplier s ON s.id = sg.supplier_id WHERE sg.goods_id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY sg.is_default DESC, sg.last_supply_time DESC
